title: S4 lens design fragment
description: One lens's output (architecture.md S4: 'per-lens design fragments (structured), merged into a draft design'). Every field S5's deterministic gates check (architecture.md S5) is required here, not bolted on after -- a fragment that can't satisfy S5 by construction is the wrong shape, not a fragment that fails validation later.

lens.description: Was a closed nine-lens enum; opened to any well-formed identifier (docs/decisions/011) so a second domain pack's own lens roster validates without a schema edit. Real membership is the loaded pack's lenses[].lens values -- enforced structurally in oah/cli.py (only a pack-declared lens is ever invoked), not by this schema.

failure_mode.description: architecture.md S5: 'telemetry failure mode is declared fail-open (telemetry loss must never break the product)' -- not a per-lens choice, a fixed invariant every fragment states explicitly so S5 can check it's present, not assumed.

signals.description: Every field/event this lens designs. S5's anti-metric-hoarding gate: 'every designed signal names at least one decision it supports and the role that acts.'

name.description: The field/attribute name as it will appear on the emitted event

surface_point_ids.description: IDs from surface_map.json this signal covers -- S5's 'every S1 surface point has a design decision' gate is: every point ID in the input surface_map appears in some signal's surface_point_ids

maps_to.description: S5: 'event fields map to OTel GenAI semantic conventions or declared oah.* extensions.'

kind.description: Was a closed ('otel_genai', 'oah_extension') enum; opened to any well-formed identifier (docs/decisions/011). Real membership is the loaded pack's attribute_kind_values -- checked by oah/design/gates.py's fields_map_to_otel_or_extension gate, not this schema.

sensitivity_tier.description: S5: 'every schema field carries a data-sensitivity tier.'

pii_masked.description: S5: 'no field is allowed to carry unmasked PII above its declared tier.' Required whenever sensitivity_tier is confidential or restricted (enforced by S5, not by this schema alone, since the rule is conditional).

supports_decision.description: What decision this signal enables -- S5's anti-metric-hoarding gate rejects a signal with none.

acting_role.description: Who acts on supports_decision -- e.g. on-call SRE, cost owner, compliance reviewer.

latency_overhead_budget_ms.description: S5: 'latency-overhead budget is declared per call path.'

cardinality_guard.description: docs/decisions/011/026: 'a route attribute is templated, never a raw path.' Optional -- set by a lens reasoning about a route-kind point's own cardinality (today: the service pack's telemetry-cost lens). is_templated: false requires unavailable_reason (S5's route_is_templated gate).

consistency_assertions.description: S5: 'declared cross-field consistency assertions... are present wherever a structured output has more than one field whose values can contradict each other.'

description.description: e.g. "restricted-access response cannot carry needs_review: false"

decision_menu_steps.description: S5: 'a decision-menu step that pauses, freezes, or throttles never ships without a paired resumption condition.'

resumption_condition.description: Required by S5 whenever type is pause/freeze/throttle -- enforced by S5, not this schema alone, since it's conditional on type.
